title: Evaluation scenario
description: One replay the harness scores (docs/evaluation.md, "Scenarios and profiles"). It states what to replay, what to inject, which ground truth applies and what passing means. It carries no failure timestamp and no fault id except as a reference: windows, accepted causes and excluded windows are resolved at load time from @fdp/ground-truth.

iso_ts.title: Instant
iso_ts.description: UTC instant with millisecond precision and a literal Z, the contracts' iso_ts.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: smoke is what CI replays, core is the test split (the core-10), dev is every scenario outside the core-10 and the held-out set (not a tuning set: the threshold sweep reads the --tuning list only), full is the E6 profile (the core-10 and eight dev scenarios, the whole recording included), heldout is the held-out set, which only its one final run replays (tools/eval/records/heldout-seal.md).

range_override.title: Range override
range_override.description: A shorter replay range for one profile. An omitted bound keeps the one of replay.

injection.title: Scheduled injection
injection.description: One injection instance, referring to packages/ground-truth/data/injections.json by id. The fault it stands for and how long it runs come from that definition, never from here.

params.description: Instance parameters, checked against the definition's bounds at load time.

id.description: The scenario id, equal to the file stem.

title.description: What the scenario replays, for a reader and for the report.

group.description: What kind of case this is. diagnostic scenarios are reported rather than gated.

profiles.description: The profiles that include this scenario. core holds exactly the test split, dev exactly the dev split and heldout exactly the heldout split, which the loader checks against split.

split.description: test is the core-10 the gate is measured on; dev is every other scenario outside the held-out set, not a tuning set (the threshold sweep reads the --tuning list of tools/eval/src/tuning.ts only); heldout is the held-out set, sealed before it was ever run and replayed once (tools/eval/records/heldout-seal.md).

positive.description: True when the scenario expects at least one ticket or review, which is what the 5/6-positives half of the gate counts.

source.description: Where the rows come from: a named slice of data/fixtures/metropt3-slices.json or the whole MetroPT-3 CSV.

replay.description: The half-open range [from, to) of the dataset clock this scenario replays, with optional per-profile overrides.

injections.description: The injections the replay applies, in schedule order.

ground_truth.description: Which ground truth applies. failure names a row of the failure table; recording takes every headline failure of the replayed range; injection takes the windows from the scheduled injections; negative, abstain and diagnostic have no positive window.

oneOf.title: Whole recording
oneOf.description: Every headline failure the replayed range covers, which is what the MetroPT-3 check of metropt3_full scores.

reason.description: Why nothing should be ticketed, in the words of the exclusion reasons or of the benign cause.

note.description: What the run is expected to show, since the scenario is reported rather than gated.

expect.description: What passing means. The latency budget is counted from max(data_onset, replay.from + warmup_min).

tickets.description: Whether a ticket is required or forbidden.

fault.description: Which cause counts as right: the window's accepted_fault_ids, the injection definition's fault_id, any benign cause or none at all, or anything.

within_min.description: Minutes the first accepted ticket may take. Positives only.

max_false_tickets.description: How many non-accepted, non-benign tickets the replayed range may produce.

pass_level.description: detection asks only that something was raised in the window; diagnosis asks that the named cause is accepted.

design_target.title: Design target
design_target.description: A design aid, not ground truth: the causes a diagnosis of the scenario's unlabelled episodes (the failure table's excluded windows with reason unlabelled_positive, resolved at load time) is read against. The tuning readout and the threshold sweep report it; no gate, exit eval, pass rule or threshold selection reads it, and the episodes stay excluded windows. Only a diagnostic scenario of the dev split may carry one, and its replayed range must hold an unlabelled episode.

accepted.description: The causes a diagnosis is read against, primary first; each must be a cause the ground-truth data names.

provenance.description: Where the target comes from and how far it is verified, in words.

native_alarm_codes.description: The controller codes lead time is measured against. Omitted means every evaluable warning and shutdown code except W116.

warmup_min.description: Samples before this many minutes of replay are fed to the pipeline but not scored.

seed.description: The seed every random source of the replay is derived from, so two runs of a profile agree.

notes.description: Why this window, what the data shows, and where that is written down.
